challenge.headline: Complex Process. Simple Experience.
challenge.challenge: Create an approachable, bilingual learning platform for people preparing for U.S. citizenship, including users who may not be comfortable with technology.
challenge.solution: Build a guided, mobile-friendly learning experience with clear navigation, organized lessons, interactive practice tools, and a streamlined enrollment flow.

items.d: Seven stages, from Welcome to the Oath Ceremony.
items.more: Each stage covers one part of the process so learners always know what comes next.

items.d: English and Spanish, one tap apart.
items.more: A language switch sits in the header, so learners can move between English and Spanish support.

items.d: Civics practice, reading & writing, mock interview prep.
items.more: Practice with instant feedback, plus progress tracking to show what needs more study.
